summary: enspara is a Python toolkit designed for scalable modeling and analysis of molecular ensembles, focusing on Markov State Models (MSMs). It provides high-performance clustering algorithms such as k-centers and k-hybrid, supporting distance metrics including RMSD, Euclidean, and Manhattan. The toolkit handles large MD datasets with threading and MPI support. enspara enables clustering across different topologies, useful for wild-type and mutant comparisons. It constructs MSMs from discrete state trajectories, offering transition-count and probability matrices, equilibrium probabilities, implied timescales, and lag-time analysis.
